notes: «قال عمرو فذكرته لعبد الرحمن» is a mentioner: Amr is not a link
The second group names a different transmitter for the same saying (Abu Maysara instead of Abdullah): a variant, never a route
«قال يحيى» gives a bare name for the first link; «قلت يا رسول الله، مثله» is Ibn Mas'ud's own speech
«قال دعه دعه» has no clear speaker in the text: left out
